shots.prompt: High-end architectural living film using this authentic interior photograph as the exact reference. Preserve the same room, window frame and muntins, dark slim armchair, rug, wood floor, plant, console and table lamp in their original positions. Very slow straight four-centimeter camera push into the room, no orbit, no pan. Natural warm window daylight, consistent perspective, detailed wood and fabric, restrained cinematic contrast. Only an almost imperceptible natural plant shadow movement. All furniture and architecture stay rigid and stationary. No new objects, people, doors or windows, no changing furniture, no text, no logo, no cut. Quiet indoor room tone only, no voice or music.
